description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for managing and inserting templates, including rendering template lists, creating template items, inserting templates into the editor, and handling keyboard navigation.

methods.name: renderTemplatesList
methods.description: Constructs the HTML view of the specified templates data and appends template items to the container.

methods.name: createTemplateItem
methods.description: Creates a template item element with preview and description, and attaches click event to insert the template.

methods.name: insertTemplate
methods.description: Inserts the selected template HTML into the editor, either replacing content or inserting at cursor position.

methods.name: keyNavigation
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the template list, enabling arrow key and enter/space interactions.
